newsitem.title: INDIA: Saudi signs deal to supply 100,OOO T LPG with IOC.
newsitem.headline: Saudi signs deal to supply 100,OOO T LPG with IOC.

text.p: Indian Oil Corp (IOC) signed an agreement earlier this week to import 100,000 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) per year from Saudi Arabian state oil company Saudi Aramco, IOC Chairman R.K. Narang said on Thursday.
Narang said the deliveries, India's first from Saudi Arabia, would begin in January.
"We will take an initial 0.1 million tonnes but we're expecting to increase the amount," he said.
Narang was speaking at the beach resort, 60 kms from Goa's capital Panaji, where the fifth international energy conference between oil producers and consumers is scheduled to take place.
The talks will be formally opened on Friday.
